tableaux.resume: Dry autumn air or indoor heating dries out the Lung: dry cough, dry throat and nose, dry skin, with no real heat.
causes: Autumn, a dry climate or dry indoor heating
tableaux.mecanisme: The Lung likes moisture. Dry air takes away its fluids: the cough turns dry, and the throat, nose and skin dry out. This is the stage before Yin Deficiency, without marked heat.
tableaux.privilegier: Pear, stewed apple, snow fungus (tremella), almonds, honey, sesame, broths, enough water.
tableaux.eviter: Heating turned up too high, spicy food, grilled food, tobacco.
conseils: Put a humidifier, or a bowl of water near the radiator, in your bedroom.
tableaux.simple: Dry air irritates your airways: dry cough, itchy throat and nose.

tableaux.resume: The Stomach lacks strength: little appetite, little sense of taste, discomfort in the pit of the stomach, tiredness especially in the morning.
tableaux.mecanisme: The Stomach receives food and “ripens” it. Without enough Qi, it doesn't take food in well: appetite and taste fade, and a dull discomfort sets in after meals.
tableaux.pouls: Empty, especially at the Stomach position (right wrist, middle position).
tableaux.moxa: Moxa is fine on CV 12 and ST 36.

items.pourquoi: Front-Mu point of the Stomach: tonifies it directly.
Supports the Spleen, the Stomach's partner.

tableaux.privilegier: Small, warm, regular meals, congee, broths, rice, steamed fish.
tableaux.eviter: Skipping breakfast, cold and raw food, eating standing up.
conseils: Eat at set times, even if only a little.
tableaux.simple: Your stomach lacks strength: little appetite, slow digestion, tired in the morning.

tableaux.resume: The deficient Stomach is also cold: dull pain relieved by warmth and by eating, cold hands, regurgitation of clear fluid.
tableaux.mecanisme: Without Yang, the Stomach no longer warms its contents: a dull pain appears on an empty stomach, eased by warmth and food, and clear fluids come back up.

principe.fr: Warm the center, harmonize the Stomach

tableaux.privilegier: Ginger, rice, squash, chicken, lamb in winter, hot drinks.
tableaux.eviter: Ice cream, cold drinks, raw fruit on an empty stomach.
conseils: Start the day with a hot drink, before you eat.
tableaux.simple: Your stomach is weak and cold: dull aches, eased by a hot meal.
reperes: Stomach pain on an empty stomach

tableaux.resume: The Gallbladder gives you the courage to decide. When it weakens: indecision, shyness, being easily startled, light sleep.
tableaux.mecanisme: In Chinese medicine, the Gallbladder governs decision-making and boldness. When its Qi is lacking, you hesitate, get frightened easily and sleep lightly, especially if Liver Blood is insufficient.

items.pourquoi: Nourishes Liver Blood, which supports the Gallbladder.

tableaux.privilegier: Foods that nourish Qi and Blood: jujubes, goji berries, grains, eggs, chicken.
conseils: Every day, make one small decision and don't go back on it: boldness is a muscle you can build.
tableaux.simple: You lack self-assurance: hard to make decisions, easily startled, light sleep.

tableaux.resume: The Bladder lacks the warmth to hold urine in: frequent urges, clear and abundant urine, leaks, cold lower belly.
tableaux.mecanisme: The Bladder stores and releases urine thanks to Kidney Qi and Yang. When these weaken, it doesn't hold well and urine becomes clear and frequent.

principe.fr: Warm the Kidney, consolidate the Bladder

items.pourquoi: Warms the Kidney and the lower belly.

tableaux.privilegier: Walnuts, leek, shrimp, mussels, lamb, hot dishes.
tableaux.eviter: Cold drinks, drinking a lot in the evening, cold feet.
conseils: Keep your lower back and feet warm.
tableaux.simple: Your bladder lacks tone and warmth: you urinate often, sometimes with leaks.
reperes: Getting up at night to urinate

tableaux.resume: Acute Cold blocks the intestines: sharp belly pain relieved by warmth, loose stools, chills.
causes: A chill caught in the belly
tableaux.mecanisme: Cold makes the intestines contract: the pain is sharp and cramping, and warmth clearly relieves it.
tableaux.moxa: Moxa or a hot-water bottle recommended.

items.pourquoi: Front-Mu point of the Large Intestine.

conseils: Hot-water bottle on your belly and a hot broth.
tableaux.simple: Cold grips your belly: intestinal cramps and loose stools after catching a chill.

tableaux.resume: The Liver lacks Yin: dry, tired eyes, blurred vision, dizziness, numbness, a slight feeling of heat in the evening.
tableaux.mecanisme: Liver Yin moistens the eyes and tendons and holds Yang in check. When it runs low, the eyes dry out, the tendons go numb and Deficiency Heat appears.
tableaux.langue: Red, especially on the edges, little coating.
tableaux.privilegier: Goji berries, chrysanthemum, black sesame, eggs, tofu, spinach, squid.
tableaux.eviter: Late-night screens, alcohol, spicy food, staying up late.
conseils: Every 20 minutes of screen time, look into the distance for 20 seconds.
tableaux.simple: Your liver is running low on resources: dry eyes, failing eyesight, dizziness, feeling warm in the evening.

tableaux.resume: Heat agitates the Blood: short cycles, heavy bright-red periods, restlessness, thirst.
tableaux.mecanisme: Heat pushes Blood out of the vessels and speeds up the cycle: periods come early, heavy and bright red.
tableaux.consulter: Very heavy periods can lead to anemia: talk to a doctor about it.
tableaux.privilegier: Green vegetables, celery, cooked cucumber, mung beans, tofu.
tableaux.eviter: Spicy food, alcohol, coffee, lamb, fried food.
tableaux.simple: Too much heat in the blood: early, heavy, bright-red periods.
